_directions.a: Default, written into each fragment: plain and warm, HR reader in mind but person-first.
_directions.b: Plain and few: the shortest honest version of each line.
_directions.c: Her words: Dr San speaking in the first person, as on the home page's practitioner section.
_directions.d: The HR brief: calm, specific and practical, for a reader who has to justify the booking.

c.h1: I help people get ready for the part of retirement money doesn’t cover.
c.lede: Human-centred retirement planning™, for your people’s psychological and social wellbeing.
c.btn: Book a chat with Dr San

d.h1: Retirement workshops for staff three to ten years out.
d.lede: Seminars, workshops and talks from Dr San, run in your workplace.
d.btn: Plan a workshop with Dr San

b.h: Retiring changes a lot more than a pay slip.
b.lede: Routine, purpose and daily company all go with the job.
b.close: Most of it can be prepared for, while they’re still at work.

c.h: After the farewell, the first Monday arrives.
c.lede: No meetings, no colleagues, nobody expecting them. That’s the part worth preparing for.
c.close: It’s far easier to plan while they’re still surrounded by colleagues.

d.h: Retirement is a people change, not just a payroll one.
d.lede: Staff lose routine, purpose and daily company on the same day, and it’s rarely planned for.
d.close: A workshop gives them time to prepare while they’re still at work.

b.note: Not sure which? Ask in the first chat.

c.lede: I shape each one around your people and the work they do.
c.note: If you’re not sure which would suit, we can work it out together in a first chat.

d.lede: From a 20-minute talk to a full-day workshop, on site or online.
d.note: Cost depends on the format and group size. Dr San will quote after a first chat.

b.note: Everyone takes home their workbook and a first plan.
